markers.note: 荒漠熱浪折射出的虛幻水城倒影，常引誘缺水旅人偏離正道。
markers.orig_note: This illusory mirage has been luring travellers out of their way for eons.

markers.name: 米特無底深淵
markers.note: 深不見底的天然地裂岩窟，在地人傳言其下連通幽深地脈，至今無人探盡。
markers.orig_note: The Halard Chasm. Locals claim that it is endlessly deep and unexplored.

markers.name: 布門古墓群
markers.note: 終年陰冷幽暗的遠古石室墓群，蜿蜒甬道間迴盪著低沉風聲。
markers.orig_note: A foreboding necropolis shrouded in perpetual darkness, where eerie whispers echo through the winding corridors and spectral guardians stand watch over the tombs of long-forgotten souls.

zones.name: 克威侵攻戰區
zones.note: 克威大軍越界攻入莫利邊境富庶地帶，劫掠圍城並佔領要地，沿途百姓紛紛逃難。
zones.orig_note: Troops of Qodstania have crossed into Sariromia in the Qodstania-Sariromian War. They raid, besiege and hold the land here, the richest along the border, and its people flee before them.

zones.name: 歐橋侵攻戰區
zones.note: 歐橋大軍越界攻入霍原邊境富庶地帶，劫掠圍城並佔領要地，沿途百姓紛紛逃難。
zones.orig_note: Troops of Bocada have crossed into Uratevryurt in the Bocada-Uratevryurtian War. They raid, besiege and hold the land here, the richest along the border, and its people flee before them.

zones.name: 格蘭侵攻戰區
zones.note: 格蘭大軍越界攻入瓦林邊境富庶地帶，劫掠圍城並佔領要地，沿途百姓紛紛逃難。
zones.orig_note: Troops of Shahriyan have crossed into Yarand in the Shahriyan-Yarandian War. They raid, besiege and hold the land here, the richest along the border, and its people flee before them.

zones.name: 討伐卡麥宗派遠征區
zones.note: 【卡麥宗派】被斥為異端，討伐軍四處搜剿信眾並焚毀其祭壇祠堂。
zones.orig_note: Puaiohelism is condemned as heresy. Crusaders march against its followers wherever they live, burning their shrines.

zones.name: 討伐澤恩離教派遠征區
zones.note: 【澤恩離教派】被斥為異端，討伐軍四處搜剿信眾並焚毀其祭壇祠堂。
zones.orig_note: Keaman Apostates is condemned as heresy. Crusaders march against its followers wherever they live, burning their shrines.

zones.name: 猩紅熱疫區
zones.note: 由遠洋船隻帶入【米蘭岬】的猩紅熱疫情，正隨往來行商與旅人沿幹道擴散。
zones.orig_note: An outbreak of scarlet fever that began in the port of Sarpse, brought by ships. Merchants and travelers carry it along the roads.

zones.name: 南岸船疫熱病區
zones.note: 由外海船隻傳入【古加津】的惡性熱病，隨商旅沿島內道路蔓延，各鎮草藥需求大增。
zones.orig_note: An outbreak of deadly fever that began in the port of Jilan, brought by ships. Merchants and travelers carry it along the roads.

zones.name: 血咳疫區
zones.note: 自【哈蘭港】靠岸船隻傳開的重症咳疫，正順著商道向內陸蔓延。
zones.orig_note: An outbreak of lethal cough that began in the port of Jing, brought by ships. Merchants and travelers carry it along the roads.

zones.name: 塞谷強震帶
zones.note: 劇烈地動重創【塞谷】及周邊鄉鎮，震塌石木屋舍並阻斷多處山道。
zones.orig_note: An earthquake has struck Tseun and the land around, toppling houses and blocking roads.

zones.name: 克登火山噴發帶
zones.note: 【克登火山】猛烈噴發，火山灰與熔岩覆蓋山麓，山腳居民被迫遷離。
zones.orig_note: Holmondle Volcano is erupting. Ash and lava cover the land around it, and people flee its slopes.

zones.name: 貝納雪崩封隘區
zones.note: 大雪崩掩埋了此處高山隘口，在積雪清通前車馬無法通行。
zones.orig_note: Avalanches have buried the mountain road here. The pass is closed until the snow is cleared.

zones.name: 阿尼地裂斷層
zones.note: 地面常年龜裂震動的深層斷層帶，極少有人敢在此處築屋定居。
zones.orig_note: A fault line where the ground cracks and shakes with frequent tremors. Few dare to build here.

zones.name: 科爾巨浪災岸
zones.note: 外海狂暴巨浪拍碎沿岸港棧並淹沒低地漁村，岸邊滿布船隻殘骸。
zones.orig_note: A great wave from the sea has struck this coast, wrecking harbors and drowning the villages along the shore.

zones.name: 沙格荒年飢饉區
zones.note: 【沙格】貧瘠鄉野連年歉收，百姓無錢向市集購糧，飢荒蔓延。
zones.orig_note: The poorest countryside of Ulan. The harvest has failed, and its people have no money to buy grain from the markets, so they go hungry.
